name: @dsh-port/ui
description: Preserved upstream web-client shell + typed desktop bridge for the Rust-core port (TypeScript/React is a documented non-Rust exception)

scripts.test: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run desktop-bridge/tests/ client-updates/tests/ native-guests/tests/
scripts.test:types: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p desktop-bridge/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p client-updates/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p native-guests/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:verify: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config shell/vite.config.ts && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run desktop-bridge/tests/ client-updates/tests/ native-guests/tests/ && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p desktop-bridge/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p client-updates/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p native-guests/tsconfig.json
